responsibility: Covers the responsibilities of the module files. compiler/rustc_lint/src/types/improper_ctypes.rs: Checks non-exhaustive enum and variant definitions for FFI-unsound shapes used by the improper_ctypes lint, identifying external non-exhaustive enums or variants whose future expansion could break ABI and returning the specific diagnostic message to emit. compiler/rustc_lint/src/types/literal.rs: Implements the literal-checking logic for type-based overflow lints, computing integer type ranges, detecting integer and float literals that do not fit their inferred types, handling special cases such as binary/hex literals, casts to char, and exclusive range endpoints, and emitting the corresponding overflowing literal diagnostics and suggestions.
